Moreover, inference-time classifier-free guidance and dense pixel-space integration introduce substantial sampling overhead, limiting practical deployment. To address these challenges, we propose CAViLD, an efficient latent diffusion framework for continuous conditional generation. CAViLD first constructs a purified condition-aware latent space through density-adaptive vicinal learning, auxiliary semantic regularization, and NIQE-guided negative data augmentation. It then internalizes the conditional guidance direction through an EMA teacher, enabling single-branch conditional inference, and introduces covariance-aware progressive distillation for label-dependent probability-flow ODEs, supporting sampling down to four NFEs. Experiments on RC-49, UTKFace, and Steering Angle demonstrate a favorable trade-off among generation fidelity, continuous condition consistency, and sampling efficiency.

</details>


### [83] [WorldFlow: Joint Video and 3D Motion Prediction via Large-Scale Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39278)
*Yuhao Lu,Jiongxu Chen,Hexiang Wei,Jiajin Wu,Juelin Li,Mingjian Liang,Fan Yang,Zhuowei Liang,Zihao Liu,Zhennan Wang,Sheng Wang,Lin Shao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究提出了一种名为WorldFlow的生成世界模型，该模型在模拟和真实世界数据上预训练，通过将3D运动参数化为与视频网格对齐的连续位移标记，并使用混合流体目标联合去噪视频和3D轨迹，从而有效解锁了预训练视频模型中嵌入的物理常识。WorldFlow在多种评估任务上表现出色，特别是在SpatialCog集上，AED降低了54.2%，同时相较于纯流体版本减少了55.9%和68.5%的AED和FDE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的视频世界模型中，3D动态被隐式处理，基于动作的表述方法局限于特定的机器人配置，并且3D运动预测模型仅使用流形监督，提供的学习信号有限。为了解决这些问题，提出了WorldFlow。

Method: WorldFlow通过将3D运动参数化为与视频网格对齐的连续位移标记，并用一个统一的混合流体目标来联合去噪视频和3D轨迹。它使用了一个混合的Transformer架构来处理这两种模态，从而实现几何动态与视觉演化的耦合。

Result: WorldFlow在1.44百万个对象级别的样本上进行了预训练，涵盖了模拟和真实世界领域。它还创建了WorldFlowBench，包含1,678个来自11个数据源的评价样本，包括空间推理任务。在所有三个评估集中，WorldFlow的表现优于其他学习方法。特别是在SpatialCog集上，WorldFlow实现了平均位移误差（ADE）为0.060 m，相比最强的外部基线降低了54.2%。与仅流形版本相比，WorldFlow降低了55.9%和68.5%的ADE和FDE。

Conclusion: WorldFlow展示了对物理常识的有效解锁和3D运动预测的新方法，提高了在各种评价任务上的性能。

Abstract: Predicting future physical states stands as a central challenge in embodied intelligence. Existing video world models leave 3D dynamics implicit, action-based formulations remain tied to specific robot configurations, and 3D motion prediction models use flow-only supervision, providing a limited learning signal for physical dynamics. To circumvent these limitations, we introduce \method{}, a generative world model that jointly predicts future video and query-based 3D trajectories. By parameterizing 3D motion as continuous displacement tokens aligned with the video grid, a unified Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) backbone jointly denoises both modalities under a rectified-flow objective. This formulation couples explicit geometric dynamics with visual evolution, effectively unlocking the physical commonsense embedded within pretrained video models. To empirically scale and validate this unified architecture, we train \method{} on a heterogeneous mixture of 1.44 million object-level samples spanning simulated and real-world domains. We further introduce WorldFlowBench, comprising 1,678 evaluation samples from 11 data sources across simulated and real-world interactions, including spatial reasoning tasks. Across all three evaluation sets, WorldFlow achieves the lowest average displacement error (ADE) and final displacement error (FDE) among the evaluated learning-based methods. Notably, on the challenging SpatialCog set, WorldFlow achieves an ADE of 0.060 m, a 54.2\% reduction compared with the strongest external baseline. It also reduces ADE and FDE by 55.9\% and 68.5\%, respectively, compared with its flow-only variant. Project page: https://worldflow-rbs.github.io/.

</details>


### [84] [PriorMaskMap: Robust Online Vectorized Map Construction with Biased Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39283)
*Haoming Xu,Wei Li,Yu Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PriorMaskMap 提出了一种名为 Prior-Aware Confidence Estimator (PACE) 的新框架，用于基于先验的向量化地图构建。PACE 评估输入的栅格化地图并赋予每个区域可靠性分数，以指导后续处理过程。该框架在 nuScenes 数据集中展示了比现有方法更高的映射精度，并且在提供包含明显错误的先验数据时表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的基于先验的方法要么将先验数据视为完全可靠的，要么只考虑少量的噪声模式，这在先验数据不准确时会导致性能显著下降。PriorMaskMap 提出了一种更鲁棒的方法来指导先验引导的向量化地图构建。

Method: PriorMaskMap 的方法包括 Prior-Aware Confidence Estimator (PACE)，它通过评估栅格化地图与当前视觉观察之间的匹配度来生成可靠性掩码，以及两个后续分支：Dual-Prior Query Generator (DPQG) 和 Confidence-Guided Prior Fusion (CGPF)。DPQG 选择性地过滤和嵌入栅格化和向量化先验来初始化可靠的查询，而 CGPF 使用改进的掩码空间传播并细化先验融合，最终生成丰富的环境上下文。

Result: PriorMaskMap 在 nuScenes 数据集上的评估结果表明，该方法在映射精度方面优于现有方法，特别是在提供包含明显错误的先验数据时表现出很高的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: PriorMaskMap 通过引入 Prior-Aware Confidence Estimator（PACE），提供了一种新的框架来增强基于先验的向量化地图构建的准确性与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Online vectorized map construction provides autonomous vehicles with essential, real-time semantic and geometric scene understanding. While leveraging prior maps presents an opportunity to improve accuracy, they are often biased due to outdated information or temporary road changes. Existing methods, which typically treat priors as fully reliable or only consider limited noise patterns, suffer severe performance degradation when these priors are imperfect. To address this, we propose PriorMaskMap, a robust framework for prior-guided vectorized map construction. Its first innovation is a Prior-Aware Confidence Estimator (PACE) that evaluates the input rasterized map against current visual observations. It assigns confidence scores to regions classified as reliable, erroneous, or blank, creating a foundational mask that guides two subsequent branches. In one branch, the Dual-Prior Query Generator (DPQG) selectively filters and embeds both rasterized and vectorized priors to initialize informative queries from trustworthy map structures. In the other, the Confidence-Guided Prior Fusion (CGPF) module spatially propagates and refines the mask, using the refined version to govern the fusion of BEV features with the prior map, thereby providing rich contextual representations for the map decoder. Evaluation on the nuScenes dataset shows that PriorMaskMap achieves superior mapping precision over existing approaches and exhibits marked robustness when provided with priors containing apparent errors. Our code is released at https://github.com/healenrens/PriorMaskMap.

</details>


### [85] [Unlocking Any-Order Generation in Pretrained Autoregressive Image Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39293)
*Rishav Pramanik,Marco Pedersoli,Zhaozheng Yin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种方法，通过利用预训练的自回归模型并结合未来的感知位置嵌入和序列表现课程，将静态扫描顺序的自回归图像生成模型转化为无序扫描顺序的自回归图像生成模型，这在ImageNet任务上的效果优于MaskGIT，在无额外附加的计算成本上，实现了图像修复、扩展和编辑。代码可在https://github.com/Ordered-AR/unlockedadaptation获取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的自回归图像生成模型虽然强大但在实际使用中有一定的局限性，尤其是在图像修复、扩展和编辑上。已有的解决方案要么需要大量计算资源，要么不兼容现有的AR模型推理生态系统。

Method: 该方法利用预训练的自回归模型，结合未来的感知位置嵌入解决目标位置可识别性问题，并通过序列表现课程引导优化路径，使模型能够适应无顺序的生成需求。

Result: 该方法在四种基础模型上实现了显著的性能提升，特别是在ImageNet任务上的图像修复与扩展任务中优于MaskGIT；此外，增加的计算成本较低，且不影响标准AR推理堆栈。

Conclusion: 研究认为，传统的自回归图像生成模型并非缺乏知识，而是缺乏将已学习到的知识以非顺序的方式表达的能力。通过该方法，该模型能够解锁图像修复、扩展和编辑的能力。

Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) image generators are powerful in principle but inflexible in practice: training with a fixed raster-scan order hardcodes a single factorization of the image distribution into the model, leaving it unable to inpaint, outpaint, or edit at inference time. Existing solutions, including the modern discrete-diffusion family, train from scratch on a mixture of token orderings, paying roughly 3x the compute of standard raster-scan training; discrete diffusion further sacrifices compatibility with the AR inference ecosystem (KV caching, vLLM) by construction. We argue that this cost is unnecessary. A pretrained raster-scan AR model has already learned the joint distribution over image tokens; what it lacks is not knowledge but the ability to express that knowledge through non-sequential conditional pathways. We propose a recipe for adapting pretrained raster-scan models into any-order generators using two components: future-aware positional embeddings that resolve a target-position identifiability problem at negligible overhead, and an ordering curriculum that traces a stable optimization path from the pretrained solution to a good any-order basin. Applied to four base models across two architectures and two scales (LlamaGen-L/XL, RAR-L/XL), the recipe substantially outperforms MaskGIT on ImageNet inpainting (FID 6.21 vs. 10.44) and outpainting, is competitive with MAR-L, trades a 1.2-1.9 increase in class-conditional FID for this flexibility, and costs 13-33% additional compute beyond pretraining, while leaving the standard AR inference stack untouched. Inpainting, outpainting, and editing, our results suggest, need not be added to autoregressive image models. They can be unlocked from the ones that exist. Code is available at https://github.com/Ordered-AR/unlockedadaptation.

</details>


### [86] [Youtu-Parsing-Omni: One Encoder, One Schema, All Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39301)
*Yunhang Shen,Zhangquan Chen,Xiaotian Li,Zhongpeng Cai,Qing Zhou,Zekai Zhang,Kun Zhang,Zezhong Wu,Jian Hu,Haihan Gao,Heting Gao,Xin Li,Yinsong Liu,Deqian Jiang,Di Yin,Haoyu Cao,Xing Sun,Bing Liu,Yanqiu Qu,Yunfei Wu,Kun Yin,Zhixiang Wei,Yongxiang Hua,Qianyu Li,Xiaoxing Hu,Peiyuan Zhang,Lijiang Li,Dong Xu,Zhenchuan Yang,Yiliang Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: YuTu-Parsing-Omni 是一种多模态解析器，能够将文档、图像、音频和视频转换为基于时空的结构化记录，通过一个统一的空间-时间坐标系统编码所有模态，并使用自适应后训练程序 OSAD 提供共享的标记-角色目标。该模型在多个基准测试中表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: YuTu-Parsing-Omni 的设计目的是为跨模态阅读、定位和引用证据提供感知层，重点解决多模态数据之间的融合和时间对齐问题。

Method: YuTu-Parsing-Omni 使用一个针对每种模态的编码器和一个用于每项任务的统一模式。模型通过预训练的语言模型初始化以增强文本阅读能力，并在统一的空间-时间坐标系统中使用共享权重编码所有模态。通过几层融合使视频帧能够关注同时的音频，实现跨模态融合和时间对齐。OmniSchema 统一了所有十个解析任务的输出，并使用自适应后训练程序 OSAD 实现共享的标记-角色目标。模型在每个回合中通过参考条件下的自身副本进行训练，并将其权重应用于自身，以实现解析器及其监督的共同进化。

Result: YuTu-Parsing-Omni 在 OmniDocBench v1.6 上达到了最先进的总体性能（96.96），并在 OmniParsingBench 中领导所有开源权重模型（75.08 平均值）。此外，该模型在图表解析总体分数中排名第一（95.02），并在化学生物指纹一致性方面达到最高精确度。它在字符水平谱乐谱转录方面也与专门的光学音乐模型相匹配，同时远远领先于通用系统。

Conclusion: YuTu-Parsing-Omni 提供了一种有效的多模态解析方法，能够高效地处理并融合文本、图像、音频和视频数据，为未来的多模态智能系统奠定了坚实的基础。

Abstract: We present Youtu-Parsing-Omni, an omni-modal parser that converts documents, images, audio, and video into structured records grounded in space and time, providing a perception layer for agents that read, locate, and cite evidence across modalities. Its design rests on one encoder for every modality and one schema for every task. Youtu-Omni-Encoder, initialized from a pre-trained language model to strengthen text reading, encodes all modalities with shared weights in a unified space-time coordinate system, and a few fusion layers let video frames attend to concurrent audio, bringing cross-modal fusion and temporal alignment into perception itself. OmniSchema unifies the outputs of all ten parsing tasks, allowing a single self-evolving post-training procedure, OmniSchema-Aware On-Policy Distillation (OSAD), to provide a shared token-role-based objective across tasks. In each round, the model is trained on its own rollouts against token-level targets from a reference-conditioned copy of itself, which is then refreshed with the trained weights, so that the parser and its supervision co-evolve. With a single 5 B-parameter checkpoint, Youtu-Parsing-Omni achieves state-of-the-art performance on OmniDocBench v1.6 (96.96 Overall) and leads all open-weight models on OmniParsingBench (75.08 Avg.), with its advantage concentrated on audio and video. It also achieves the best overall chart-parsing score (95.02) and the highest exact chemical-fingerprint agreement among compared systems, and matches a dedicated optical-music model in character-level transcription of typeset sheet music while staying far ahead of general-purpose systems. Code and model weights are publicly available.

</details>


### [87] [CAD-WAM: Anticipating Geometry for Text-to-CAD Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39306)
*Zhengyang Li,Weijie Zheng,Yuxin Cui,Sijie Wang,Wenjie Feng,Qiyu Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CAD-WAM 使用几何条件化的操作生成并与下一状态预测相结合的方法，显著提高了 CAD 模型生成的几何准确性和输出有效性，特别是在需要更多操作的模型上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于大语言模型 (LLMs) 的方法主要学习预测命令，而没有明确监督这些命令应产生的几何状态。为了解决这一问题，论文提出 CAD-WAM 方法，其结合几何条件化的动作生成和未来状态预测。

Method: CAD-WAM 将动作生成和未来状态预测结合，使用 CAD 领域特定语言 (DSL) 定义完整建模动作，并通过预训练的变分自编码器编码中间实体的表面点云。该方法利用大语言模型（LLM）生成动作并预测未来状态以提供几何监督。

Result: 在 DeepCAD 测试集上，CAD-WAM 在几何准确性和输出有效性方面优于专用基线，并在需要更多操作的模型上表现更好。此外，消融实验显示，未来状态监督能使均方差距离减少 13.2%。

Conclusion: 该研究提出了 CAD-WAM，通过结合几何条件化的操作生成和未来状态预测，显著提高了多步骤生成过程中几何模型的准确性和有效性。

Abstract: Generating editable computer-aided design (CAD) models from text requires selecting operations that produce the intended changes to the geometry constructed so far. An incorrect operation can compromise subsequent steps, making reliable multi-step generation challenging. Existing methods based on large language models (LLMs) primarily learn to predict commands, without explicit supervision of the geometric states those commands should produce. Inspired by world-action models, we introduce CAD-WAM, which couples geometry-conditioned action generation with next-state prediction. We define complete modeling operations as actions in a CAD domain-specific language (DSL) and encode surface point clouds of intermediate solids into compact latent states using a pretrained variational autoencoder. An LLM backbone generates the next action from the target description and current geometric state, while an auxiliary head on the same backbone predicts the next state to provide geometric supervision during training. We construct step-wise training trajectories from parametric CAD models in the DeepCAD dataset, pairing each trajectory with an expert-level textual description. At inference, each generated action is executed by a CAD kernel, and the resulting solid is re-encoded to inform the next decision. On the DeepCAD test set, CAD-WAM outperforms the task-specific baselines in geometric accuracy and output validity, with larger gains on models requiring more operations, and produces more accurate geometry than general-purpose LLMs prompted with the same DSL. Ablations further show that next-state supervision reduces mean Chamfer distance by 13.2\% relative to an otherwise identical model trained only to predict actions. Code is available at https://github.com/Lzy-1037/CAD-WAM.

</details>


### [88] [MemoryFusion: Cross-Temporal Memory Learning for Multimodal Video Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39322)
*Meiqi Gong,Hao Zhang,Jiayi Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MemoryFusion 提出了一种两阶段框架，结合了跨时域记忆学习和逐步时间精炼方法，能够实现高质量且时间一致的视频融合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法主要依赖于短期时间联系，无法充分利用长短时信息。MemoryFusion 旨在解决这一问题，通过结合短期和长期时间记忆，以及平滑模块减少时间抖动，从而提供更一致的视频融合。

Method: MemoryFusion 包含两个阶段：第一阶段结合了短期记忆库和长期记忆库，用于局部和历史信息的融合引导；第二阶段利用轻量级的 3D 时域精炼模块进一步精炼并增强结构细节。

Result: 大量实验表明，MemoryFusion 可在各个融合质量和时间一致性指标上显著超越现有基于帧和基于视频的融合方法。

Conclusion: MemoryFusion 为视频融合提供了一种新的框架，不仅提高了融合质量，还保证了时间一致性，具有很高的研究价值和应用潜力。

Abstract: Multimodal videos contain rich temporal cues that can facilitate faithful fusion. However, existing video fusion methods mainly rely on short-range temporal interactions, leaving valuable long-term information underexplored. Moreover, inconsistent fusion representations can cause flickering artifacts, undermining temporal coherence. To address these coupled challenges, we propose MemoryFusion, a two-stage framework integrating cross-temporal memory learning with progressive temporal refinement. Considering the complementary roles of adjacent and distant frames, the first stage combines a Short-Term Memory Bank for local temporal guidance with a Long-Term Memory Bank that preserves reliable historical information through a fusion-oriented update strategy. To mitigate temporal fluctuations, a Temporal Smoothing Module leverages soft motion cues for coarse background stabilization. Building upon the resulting fusion prior, The second stage further employs a lightweight 3D residual Temporal Refinement Module to correct remaining temporal inconsistencies while enhancing structural details. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MemoryFusion achieves superior fusion quality and temporal consistency over existing frame-based and video-based fusion methods. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Meiqi-Gong/MemoryFusion.

</details>


### [89] [MRC-MMAgent: Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Role Collaboration in Multimodal Tool-Using Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39324)
*Shengqin Wang,Jie Jin,Xiaofan Li,Wentao Yan,Yu Cheng,Qingsong HuYihang Chen,Weilin Luo,Jingyu Gong,Xin Tan,Yuan Xie,Zhizhong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种名为MRC-MMAgent的多角色协作强化学习框架，该框架通过嵌入轨迹评估和继续执行子过程优化了代理在解题过程中自我纠正的能力。实验表明，这种方法在不额外构建数据集的情况下，相对于基线模型有显著提升，并在多个基准测试中表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的强化学习管道主要针对单角色代理进行训练，并忽略了人类在搜索过程中回检证据、重塑查询和修正结论的过程，从而导致无法优化自我纠正过程在整个交互轨迹中的效果。

Method: 该方法构建了一个多角色协作的循环，整合了解题、检查和继续，使得代理能够通过工具获取证据，评估前序轨迹，并在当前解题结果不足时恢复问题求解。进一步引入了一种角色耦合的学习目标，结合任务成功、互动有效性以及成功纠正，在整个决策路径上进行全面策略优化。

Result: 实验证明，这种方法在仅使用原始基线训练集的情况下，相对基线模型表现更为优异，且在多个基准测试中取得了领先或竞争力极强的表现。

Conclusion: 该研究展示了多角色协作的强化学习框架能够显著提升视觉语言模型的多模态工具使用能力，为解决知识密集型和视觉复杂任务提供了新的视角和方法。

Abstract: Multimodal tool-using agents augment vision-language models with access to external information and capabilities, enabling them to solve knowledge-intensive and visually complex tasks that cannot be addressed using visual context alone. However, existing reinforcement learning pipelines largely train single-role agents to search and answer using terminal rewards, overlooking how humans inspect retrieved evidence, reformulate queries, and revise conclusions during search. Consequently, they fail to optimize this self-corrective process over complete interaction trajectories. We propose MRC-MMAgent, a multi-role collaborative reinforcement learning framework that incorporates trajectory assessment and continuation directly into the executable agent loop. First, the framework establishes a multi-role collaborative loop that integrates solving, inspection, and continuation, enabling the agent to acquire evidence through tools, evaluate the preceding trajectory, and resume problem solving when the current answer is insufficiently supported. Second, we introduce a role-coupled learning objective that combines task success, interaction validity, and successful correction with full-trajectory policy optimization across the decisions generated by all roles. Extensive experiments show that, using only the original baseline training set without constructing additional datasets, our method consistently outperforms the corresponding base models and achieves leading or highly competitive performance across benchmarks.

</details>


### [90] [Can Image Agents Complete Visual Commissions? A Benchmark and Modular Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39330)
*Tong Li,Lishuai Gao,Qi Zeng,Yifan Li,Cong Wei,Zhuoliang Kang,Xiaoming Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究提出了Visual Commission Bench (VCB)，包含600项任务，涵盖12个类别，评估视觉委托任务的内容正确性、视觉实现、约束保留和交付完整性，同时介绍了V-Protocol参考代理，其在多种基准上的表现优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的评估方法仅关注特定能力和执行环境，而忽视了端到端的委托完成情况。因此，为了提供一个全面的评估平台，以更好地理解视觉委托完成的全过程，提出了Visual Commission Bench (VCB)和相应的V-Protocol参考代理。

Method: VCB包含600个任务，分为12个类别，三个互补等级。V-Protocol通过动态组合可重用的任务、认知和表达模块，在推理时生成解决方案，所有模块之间共享执行框架。

Result: V-Protocol在VCB上实现了69.0%的严格任务成功率，高于基线的42.0%。在Mind-Bench上，其严格准确率提高了6%。

Conclusion: Visual Commission Bench (VCB) 提供了一个全面的评估框架，有助于更好地理解视觉委托的完成过程，而V-Protocol作为一个参考代理，证明了其在视觉委托任务中的应用潜力。

Abstract: Visual commissions require image agents to integrate heterogeneous source materials, preserve requirements across dependent stages, and produce coordinated deliverables. Existing evaluations examine specific capabilities and execution settings, leaving end-to-end commission completion less understood. We introduce Visual Commission Bench (VCB), comprising 600 tasks across 12 categories and three complementary tiers, from capability-focused tasks to complete commissions. VCB uses 5,039 requirement checks and separate visual quality ratings to assess content correctness, visual realization, constraint preservation, and delivery completeness without prescribing an internal workflow. We present V-Protocol, a reference agent that dynamically composes reusable task, cognitive, and expression modules at inference time. Task modules organize delivery, cognitive modules derive content, and expression modules guide visual realization. The modules exchange structured intermediate artifacts, while a shared execution harness tracks artifact revisions and dependencies, manages tool execution, and checks completion. With the same controller and image generator as the agent baselines, V-Protocol achieves 69.0\% strict task success on VCB, compared with 42.0\% for SCOPE. On Mind-Bench, strict accuracy increases from 39.2\% to 45.4\%.

</details>


### [91] [Telling Is Not Seeing: Textual Personas Rarely Make Vision-Language Models Answer Like the People They Describe](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39331)
*Jiawei Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究发现，尽管使用 personas 提示 VLMs 能让模型声称代表特定人群（如低视力者），但模型的实际视觉表现并没有优于基于事实的简单规则，甚至未能准确反映这些人群的真实视觉差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究 personas 如何影响 VLMs 生成视觉感知与人类真实体验的一致性。

Method: 通过对比模型使用 personas 生成的视觉识别结果与实际低视力者或有其他视觉障碍人群的数据以及基于事实的简单规则的表现。

Result: 实验结果显示，使用 personas 的模型在视觉识别上的表现不如基于事实的简单规则，且未能准确反映不同群体之间的视觉差异；描述模糊度不会改变模型的识别能力，只有实际模糊图片的效果才会降低识别率。

Conclusion: 研究证实，仅凭 personas 无法让 VLMs 达到人类真实的视觉感知水平，模型实际表现主要依赖于输入数据而非描述性的提示。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly prompted with personas, such as "You have low vision", to stand in for people in user studies. We ask whether a persona makes a model see like the person it describes. We compare persona answers with measured people with low vision, color blindness or hearing loss, and with simple rules that use only the facts the persona states. The persona never beats these rules, and it erases the real differences between groups and individuals. Describing blur leaves recognition unchanged in all 14 models we test, while blurring the photo lowers it as it does for people. Inside open models, the description changes neither the image information nor the answer probabilities. Yet the models know the effects they fail to show: they can estimate how blur and illusions affect people. Telling is not seeing: a persona makes a model say what it knows about people, not see what they see.

</details>


### [92] [PicturePerfect: Diffusion-based Same-identity Facial Replacement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39344)
*Manik Dhingra,Yashesh Savani,Mahesh Reddy,Antoine Mercier,Jiahe Liu,Guillaume Berger*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的人脸替换方法，能够在保持背景不变的情况下，将输入图像中的人脸替换成参考图像中的人脸，且生成的效果更加真实和身份一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在扩散模型在计算机视觉中取得成功的情况下，探索其在照片中进行同身份人脸替换的潜力。

Method: 该方法基于预先训练好的文本到图像模型，输入一个人物的肖像照片和该人的另一张参考照片，替换输入人脸为参考人脸。

Result: 实验结果表明，本文提出的方法生成的效果比现有面部重演模型更加真实和身份一致。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一种创新的人脸替换方法，且展示了其有效性和优越性。

Abstract: With the growing success of diffusion models in computer vision, we explore their potential for same-identity facial replacement in photographs. Specifically, we propose a diffusion-based method, built on top of a pre-trained text-to-image model, that takes as input a portrait image of a person and a second reference image of the same individual, potentially captured under different conditions. The goal is to seamlessly replace the input face with the reference face, while keeping the background intact. Surprisingly, despite the clear real-world utility of this task, no recently published work has directly addressed face replacement in this specific setting. To support this goal, we construct a large dataset of image pairs depicting the same person under varying facial expressions and poses. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach produces more realistic and identity-consistent results than existing face reenactment models.

</details>


### [93] [Semantic Mismapping in Generalized Category Discovery: Evaluation and Mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39356)
*Zitai Wang,Qianqian Xu,Cong Hua,Xi Chen,Zhiyong Yang,Xiaochun Cao,Qingming Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究针对GCD方法中存在的全局匹配问题，提出了Semantics-Preserving Evaluation (SPE)和Mismapping-Mitigating Optimization (MMO)以提升新类别的识别准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的GCD方法虽然改善了旧类别识别和新类别发现，但仍使用全局匹配，这可能导致旧类别预测错误被隐藏。本文通过分析这一误区提出了解决方案。

Method: 研究首先定义了语义偏离映射现象，然后提出了Semantics-Preserving Evaluation (SPE) 和 Mismapping-Mitigating Optimization (MMO)，后者包括区域平衡损失和新颖多样性损失。这些方法旨在防止语义偏离映射并提高新类别的准确性。

Result: 实验结果表明，使用GH和SPE评估时，本文提出的方法优于现有技术。

Conclusion: 本文通过引入SPE和MMO解决了GCD中的问题，提高了新类别的识别准确性。

Abstract: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) aims to perform old-category recognition and novel-category discovery in the same unlabeled set. Early methods address both objectives through clustering and evaluate the exchangeable predicted indices with global Hungarian (GH) matching. Recent methods adopt trainable parametric heads, using supervision for old-category recognition and discovery-oriented objectives for new categories. In this way, the output space becomes partially exchangeable: old indices are semantically anchored, while new indices remain exchangeable. However, these methods still apply global matching, which can reassign anchored old indices to other categories and hide some prediction errors. Empirically, we are surprised to observe that this reassignment can induce an overestimation of new-category accuracy by up to 25.63 points. We term this phenomenon semantic mismapping and further derive a permutation-cycle condition that characterizes when semantic mismapping can increase the global matching score. To fix this issue, we propose Semantics-Preserving Evaluation (SPE), which preserves the supervised semantics of old indices and restricts Hungarian matching to the new region. Furthermore, we propose Mismapping-Mitigating Optimization (MMO) to alleviate the prediction errors that can give rise to semantic mismapping, combining a region-balance loss (RBL) for old/new routing with a novel-diversity loss (NDL) that encourages orthogonality among new prototypes. Theoretically, we show that minimizing the two losses can tighten an upper bound on spurious accuracy gains from semantic mismapping, with controllable residual terms. Empirical results under both GH and SPE demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method.

</details>


### [94] [CASE: Concept-Aware Segmentation from Positive and Negative Visual Exemplars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39396)
*Yi-Jen Tsai,Yen-Yu Lin,Chien-Yao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出了Specified Visual Prompt Segmentation (SVPS) 任务，并引入了BENCHMARK CASE，通过将正负视觉提示结合来识别更精确的目标对象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的Few-shot semantic segmentation方法依赖于单一语义类别的正样本支持示例进行目标对象识别，但往往缺乏足够的上下文信息。因此，通过引入负样本提示，可以进一步改进目标识别的准确性。

Method: 该研究通过建立SPECIFIED VISUAL PROMPT SEGMENTATION (SVPS) 任务，结合Positive and Negative Visual Exemplars（正负视觉提示）来优化目标分割模型。引入了Concept Prompt Adaptation (CPA) 方法，基于LoRA进行调整。

Result: 研究者评估了SAM 3在SVPS任务上的表现，并展示了如何使用CPA提升正负样本提示的解释能力，保持在仅有正面提示的few-shot分割任务中也有竞争力。

Conclusion: 提出了SPECIFIED VISUAL PROMPT SEGMENTATION (SVPS) 框架和Benchmark CASE数据集，通过整合正负视觉提示提高了分割模型的精确性，尤其适用于需要精细语义分割的任务场景。

Abstract: Few-shot semantic segmentation typically identifies target objects based on positive support examples of a single semantic class. In practice, however, positive cues alone are often underspecified: for instance, "red cars" may be confused with cars of all colors, "vehicles" may include cars that should be excluded, and "material-defined objects" may span multiple categories. Fulfilling precise requests requires positive exemplars to provide inclusion evidence and negative exemplars to act as intent-defining constraints for exclusion and disambiguation. We formulate this setting as Specified Visual Prompt Segmentation (SVPS), where the target concept is specified by both positive and negative visual prompts. In this work, visual exemplars refer to support-image regions specified by bounding-box prompts. To study SVPS, we introduce CASE (Concept-Aware Segmentation from Positive and Negative Visual Exemplars), a benchmark built on COCO and PACO. CASE encompasses six category- and attribute-level task families: exclusion, isolation, union, attribute exclusion, attribute isolation, and attribute union. We evaluate SAM 3 under this setting and find that, despite its powerful positive-only few-shot segmentation capability, frozen SAM 3 does not consistently treat negative visual prompts as exclusion evidence. To address this, we present Concept Prompt Adaptation (CPA), a conservative LoRA-based adaptation baseline that improves positive-negative prompt interpretation on CASE while remaining competitive under positive-only few-shot segmentation. Code is available at https://github.com/WongKinYiu/FSS-CASE.

</details>


### [95] [ACD-GS: Asymmetric Curvature-aware Densification for 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39399)
*Houqiang Zhong,Tianchi Zhu,Qiang Hu,Xiaoyun Zhang,Li Song,Wenjun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ACD-GS 提出了一个新颖的 3D Gaussian 紧凑优化框架，通过二阶深度响应和多视图光度一致性约束，减少冗余的高斯分布生成，并提高几何重建的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的 3D 油画涂抹技术在训练时的密度增强主要依赖于初步的一阶屏幕空间梯度，这可能导致几何细节的不准确再现。ACD-GS 提出了基于二阶深度响应和多视图光度一致性的方法，以更可靠地控制密度，避免过度分裂。

Method: ACD-GS 方法包括两个主要组成部分：1) 基于二阶深度响应的非对称密度调控机制，2) 多视图光度一致性约束。此外，引入了容量感知的自适应调节策略来平衡训练中的密度增强和修剪。

Result: 实验表明，ACD-GS 在保持渲染保真度的同时，能够减少近 60% 的高斯体素数量和存储空间，并且在多个数据集上优于现有的方法。

Conclusion: ACD-GS 提供了一种有效减少冗余高斯体素生成的方法，可以使用该方法构建准确的几何表示。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for real-time photorealistic novel view synthesis. However, its training-time densification remains largely heuristic, often resulting in redundant Gaussian proliferation and inaccurate geometric reconstruction. Existing methods predominantly rely on first-order screen-space gradients to trigger cloning and splitting, which fail to distinguish true geometric discontinuities from high-frequency textures or noisy residuals. To address this limitation, we propose ACD-GS, an Asymmetric Curvature-aware Densification framework for compact and geometry-aware 3D Gaussian optimization. Our key insight is that second-order depth responses provide a more reliable structural prior for density control, enabling asymmetric regulation of cloning and splitting to better capture geometric discontinuities. Building on this, we introduce a multi-view photometric consistency constraint to suppress transient single-view errors, together with a capacity-aware adaptive regulation strategy that balances densification and pruning during training. Unlike post-hoc compression or quantization-based approaches, ACD-GS directly prevents redundant Gaussian generation during training, yielding inherently compact representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method reduces nearly 60% of Gaussian count and storage while maintaining competitive rendering fidelity, consistently outperforming existing methods across multiple datasets. Our code is available in https://waveviewer.github.io/ACD-GS/.

</details>


### [96] [SymKL: A Unified Representation-Space Measure of Signal Degradation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39403)
*Dhananjaya Jayasundara,Sudarshan Rajagopalan,Vishal M. Patel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SymKL 是一种基于隐神经表示的统一全参考退化度量，通过估算对数似然的 Fisher 信息并计算其对称 KL 散度来定量描述信号退化程度，适用于图像、音频和 3D 数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有信号降级度量方法大多针对特定模态，而 SymKL 旨在提供一种通用的、跨模态的信号降级度量方法以更好地评估信号的降级程度。

Method: SymKL 方法首先通过将隐神经表示（INR）拟合到原始参考信号上，获取描述学习表示局部信息几何的对角 Fisher 信息。接下来，通过原始参考信号和退化观测信号评估 Fisher 信息，得到两个参数敏感性曲线，其对称 KL 散度即为信号退化分数。此外，对 SIREN（一种常见神经网络模型）的对角 Fisher 信息给出了精确的闭式表达式，提供了高效的计算途径。

Result: 在图像、语音和体数据基准测试中的实验表明，SymKL 能够准确追踪信号降级程度，不仅在常规度量饱和或失效的地方保持单调性，同时也提供了一种统一的跨模态降级测量。

Conclusion: SymKL 是一种新颖的、高效的信号降级度量方法，适用于多种数据类型，并且其闭式表达式的获取有助于实际应用和推广。

Abstract: Quantifying degradation between a pristine signal and its degraded observation is fundamental to signal processing, yet existing full-reference measures are inherently modality-specific. We introduce SymKL, a unified full-reference degradation measure based on implicit neural representations (INRs). An INR is fitted once to the pristine reference and characterized by its diagonal Fisher information, which captures the local information geometry of the learned representation. Evaluating the Fisher information with the pristine reference and a degraded observation yields two parameter-sensitivity profiles whose symmetric KL divergence defines the degradation score. The proposed formulation requires only the reference and degraded observation, without knowledge of the corruption process or degradation severity, making it applicable across images, audio, and 3D data. We further derive an exact closed-form expression for the diagonal Fisher of SIREN, enabling efficient computation. Experiments on image, speech, and volumetric 3D benchmarks demonstrate that SymKL accurately tracks degradation severity, remains monotonic where conventional metrics saturate or fail, and provides a unified modality-agnostic measure of signal degradation. Code will be made publicly available after the review process.

</details>


### [97] [YOLOF-MLD: A Multi-Level Distillation Framework for Efficient Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39408)
*Xiaolong Wu,Liming Zheng,Zitong Liu,Yue Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: YOLOF-MLD 提出了一种针对边缘设备的高效物体检测框架，通过结合 YOLO26n 的主干、单输入单输出颈和多级蒸馏，实现了参数量减少 35.7%，同时在 Raspberry Pi 5 上的速度提升 62.3%，适用于资源受限的边缘设备，特别是在火灾烟雾监控等安全关键应用中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前轻量级的 YOLO26 框架虽轻量但依赖参数密集的特征金字塔网络（FPN），限制了其在资源受限边缘设备上的优势。要提高其实时性和准确性。

Method: 提出 YOLOF-MLD 框架，结合了 YOLO26n 的主干、单输入单输出颈和多级蒸馏（MLD），通过骨架特征对齐、颈部感受野对齐和响应级别对齐技术来优化模型。

Result: 在 D-Fire 和 Annotated Fire-Smoke (AFS) 数据集上的测试结果显示，YOLOF-MLD 使 YOLO26n 的参数量减少了 35.7%，并在 Raspberry Pi 5 上实现了 62.3% 的速度提升。相较于 YOLO26n，YOLOF-MLD 在 D-Fire 和 AFS 数据集上分别达到了 71.6% 和 59.9% 的 mAP@50，表明其在准确性和延迟之间有良好的权衡。

Conclusion: YOLOF-MLD 提供了在边缘部署中一个具有竞争力的准确性和延迟折衷方案，特别适合火灾烟雾监测等安全关键应用。

Abstract: Efficient object detection on resource-constrained edge devices is essential for safety-critical applications such as fire-smoke monitoring. However, current lightweight frameworks, such as YOLO26, still rely on the parameter-dense multi-branch Feature Pyramid Network (FPN), preventing full exploitation of their lightweight advantage. Replacing FPN with YOLOF's single-input-single-output (SiSo) neck is a promising solution but causes substantial accuracy loss. To alleviate this, we propose YOLOF-MLD, a CPU-efficient multi-level distillation (MLD) framework that combines a YOLO26n backbone, a SiSo neck, and MLD. It aligns features at the backbone via sliced-semantics matching, neck with receptive-field matching, and response levels. On D-Fire and Annotated Fire-Smoke (AFS) datasets, YOLOF-MLD reduces the parameter count of YOLO26n by 35.7\% and achieves a 62.3\% speedup on Raspberry Pi 5, attaining 71.6% and 59.9% mAP@50, respectively, compared with 75.5% and 60.0% for YOLO26n. These results demonstrate a competitive accuracy--latency trade-off for edge deployment. Our code is available at https://github.com/XiaolongWU111/YOLOF---MLD/blob/main/README.md.

</details>


### [98] [Anatomical Prior-Guided Routing for 3D Lung Tumor Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39414)
*Uihyeon Maeng,Jonghun Kim,Hyunjin Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于肺肿瘤分割的解剖先验引导路由模块（APRM），通过确定性选择解剖学路由门来实现解剖学区域特异性的特征适应，同时在多个区域共享专家能力，从而改善了特征处理的适应性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的3D医学图像分割方法在处理小体积和异质性高的肺肿瘤时存在局限性，尤其是由于局部图像补丁难以提供充足的全局解剖背景，导致模型难以适应不同解剖区域的特征处理。

Method: 提出了一种Anatomical Prior-guided Routing Module (APRM)，通过为每个图像补丁获取区域占用的解剖先验信息，并确定性地选择一个解剖学路由门，该门将执行稀疏特征路由以实现解剖学区域特异性的特征适应，同时在不同区域共享专家能力的池中进行。

Result: 在两个数据集上评估APRM，并使用各种骨干网络展示了其与基础模型相比的一致改进。特征可视化结果显示APRM根据补丁位置产生了不同的特征响应，表明提出的路由机制能够根据解剖上下文有效调整特征处理。

Conclusion: 该方法通过增强特征处理的适应性，从而提高了肺部肿瘤分割的准确性，为3D肺部肿瘤分割的应用提供了有效的模块化组件。

Abstract: Accurate lung tumor segmentation in computed tomography (CT) is essential for treatment planning, response assessment, and quantitative imaging analysis. However, 3D lung tumor segmentation remains challenging because tumors occupy only a small portion of the whole volume and exhibit heterogeneous appearances across anatomical locations. In patch-based training and sliding-window inference for 3D medical image segmentation, location-dependent heterogeneity is further amplified because cropped image patches provide limited global anatomical context, making it difficult for a model to adapt its feature processing according to the anatomical region from which each patch is extracted. To address this limitation, we propose an Anatomical Prior-guided Routing Module (APRM) for lung tumor segmentation. For each image patch, we obtain anatomical prior information of regional occupancy and deterministically select an anatomical routing gate. The selected gate then performs sparse feature routing over a shared expert adapter pool, enabling anatomy-specific feature adaptation while sharing expert capacity across regions. We evaluate APRM on two datasets with various backbone networks and demonstrate consistent improvements over baseline models. Furthermore, feature visualizations show that APRM produces different feature responses depending on patch location, indicating that the proposed routing mechanism effectively adapts feature processing according to anatomical context.

</details>


### [99] [Diagnosing the Reference Gap: What Visual Scaffolds Can and Cannot Fix in Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39419)
*Guizhen Chen,Weiwen Xu,Wotao Yin,Anh Tuan Luu,Hou Pong Chan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究展示了引入外部参考可以显著提高多模态语言模型在视觉推理任务中的表现，尤其在匹配任务时效果最为明显。这项发现指出了参考缺口作为多模态推理的一个瓶颈，表明任务适配的视觉参考可以作为一种无需额外训练的视觉技能来提升模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机基于视觉程理论，探索外部参考如编号是否能减少语言与视觉实体之间的参考缺口，以改进多模态语言模型的跨步骤视觉推理能力。

Method: 研究者设计了名为ReGap-Bench的新基准测试，包含了五个固定场景和问题的答案，但参考策略不同。通过对比匹配和不匹配参考策略的表现，来评估参考对于模型表现的影响。

Result: 研究结果表明，匹配任务的参考策略能够显著提升模型的准确性，高达25%，而不匹配的参考策略几乎没有提供额外的帮助甚至可能损害模型性能。

Conclusion: 研究结论认为参考缺口是多模态推理的一个独立瓶颈，任务适配的视觉参考能够作为一种无需训练的视觉技能提高模型的多模态推理能力。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models can recognize visual content yet struggle to reason reliably over it across multiple steps. In counting, a model may see all objects but lose track of which ones it has counted. We argue that such failures, commonly attributed to perception, reveal a reference gap: the failure to bind language to the relevant visual entities, regions, or locations. Motivated by the theory of visual routines, we test whether external references such as numbering can narrow this gap. We introduce ReGap-Bench, a paired benchmark of five visual reasoning tasks in which the scene, question, and answer are fixed and only the reference varies. Results show that task-matched references improve accuracy by up to 25\%, while mismatched references provide little benefit or even hurt performance. These findings identify the reference gap as a bottleneck distinct from visual perception and show that constructing task-appropriate visual references can serve as a training-free visual skill for improving multimodal reasoning.

</details>


### [100] [FDSML: Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning with Parameter-Aware Triplet Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39423)
*Hina Otake,Shinei Arakawa,Keitaro Tanaka,Yoshihiro Fukuhara,Hirokatsu Kataoka,Shigeo Morishima*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种称为FDSML的方法，通过从图像生成参数中推导关系监督，而不是仅仅使用离散类别标签，从而提高了预训练的迁移性和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的视觉预训练方法将预训练视为对离散标签的分类，这可能会丢失生成过程中的连续性。本文旨在通过引入基于生成参数的关系监督，来改善预训练的效果。

Method: FDSML方法结合了FineFractalDB数据集和Parameter-Aware Triplet Loss（PA-Triplet损失），后者根据基础迭代函数系统参数空间中的距离来分配正样本和负样本，旨在训练嵌入到参数导引的相对相似性顺序。

Result: 实验结果显示，FDSML不仅在图像检索上的表现优于FDSL预训练，还提高了下游分类的性能并增强了在多种干扰设置下的鲁棒性。在ResNet-50模型上，Stanford Online Products数据集的Recall@1从65.6%提高到74.0%，Stanford Cars数据集的Recall@1从56.2%提高到78.4%。

Conclusion: 本文的研究结果表明，基于参数的关系监督比基于标签的分类提供了更强的合成预训练信号，有助于实现识别之外的任务的迁移。

Abstract: Formula-Driven Supervised Learning (FDSL) enables vision pre-training without real images, but existing methods cast pre-training as classification on discretized labels, discarding continuity in the generative process. We propose Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning (FDSML), which derives relational supervision from image-generation parameters beyond discrete class labels. FDSML combines FineFractalDB, our refined fractal dataset with higher intra-class variation and more stable structures, with a Parameter-Aware Triplet (PA-Triplet) Loss that assigns positives and negatives according to distances in the underlying Iterated Function System parameter space. This objective trains embeddings to respect parameter-derived relative similarity orderings. Experiments show that FDSML improves transferability to image retrieval while remaining competitive on downstream classification and improving robustness under several corruption settings. On ResNet-50, Recall@1 improves from 65.6% to 74.0% on Stanford Online Products and from 56.2% to 78.4% on Stanford Cars over FDSL pre-training. These results suggest that parameter-derived relational supervision provides a stronger synthetic pre-training signal than label-based classification for transfer beyond recognition.

</details>


### [101] [PathCowork: Learning from real-world pathology practice to build AI copilots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39441)
*Sheng Wang,Jialu Yao,Maria V. Rossi,Shunsuke Koga,Esther Baranov,MacLean P. Nasrallah,Songhao Li,Jonathan Xu,Wei Du,Cindy McGrath,Timothy Chao,Anne Wang,Zhaohai Yang,Daniel Akuma,Selemon M. Walle,Olga Pozdnyakova,Edward B. Lee,Zahra Alipour,Annapurna Saksena,Rashmi Tondon,Nikolina Dioufa,David E. Elder,George J. Netto,Xiaowei Xu,Zhi Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PathCowork框架通过记录病理学家的检查过程，用于训练视觉定位和指导诊断AI，显著提升了AI在处理病理图像时的表现，尤其在前列腺分级任务中表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗AI大多依赖于医生的记录答案进行学习，而忽略了他们如何基于证据做出判断的过程。PathCowork框架旨在通过记录病理学家的检查过程，增加透明的推理步骤，改进视觉定位和指导诊断AI。

Method: PathCowork框架结合了同步视线、叙述和导航，将视觉发现与解释过程联系起来。通过该平台收集的数据，训练了两种不同的模型以适应不同的部署场景。

Result: 在五个特定器官的评估中，结合视觉定位与记录的诊断流程，PathCowork的AI相较于Claude Code和Codex分别取得17.9和24.1个百分点的提升，同时处理时间和推理成本更低。与其他最先进的AIs相比，PathCowork中的AI提出的区域表现更好，尤其是在前列腺评分任务中。

Conclusion: PathCowork开辟了通过透明推理从常规临床实践中直接学习的新型数据收集和训练病理AI的方法，展示了在病理学领域显著的进步。

Abstract: Medical AI learns from the answers doctors record, but rarely from how they interpret the evidence to reach them. Here we introduce PathCowork, a framework that turns pathologists' narrated examinations into supervision for visual grounding and procedures that guide diagnostic AI agents. Synchronized gaze, narration and navigation link visual findings to the process of interpreting them. Across 48 sessions from 16 pathologists, the platform captured 1,028 minutes of slide review. Using these data, we trained PathCowork-1T for server deployment and PathCowork-27B for local deployment, with improved visual grounding. Across five organ-specific evaluations, agents combining this grounding with recorded diagnostic procedures achieved primary task scores averaging 17.9 and 24.1 percentage points higher than Claude Code and Codex, respectively, with shorter processing times and lower inference costs. Compared to the state-of-the-art multiple-instance learning AIs, the PathCowork agent-proposed regions achieved higher prostate-grading scores with limited slide labels. PathCowork can also help construct pathology AI benchmarks where questions derived from the recordings identified difficulties in recognizing viewing context and rejecting inapplicable premises. In summary, PathCowork proposes a new paradigm to scale up the data collection and train pathology AI through transparent reasoning from diagnostic sessions, opening a path towards systems that learn directly from routine clinical practice.

</details>


### [102] [Calibrating Attention-Based Token Pruning for Efficient Multi-Image Synthesis in UMMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39467)
*Zimeng Wu,Qijian Tian,Penghui Du,Changqian Yu,Jiaxin Chen,Yunhong Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CATP 提出了一种无需训练的上下文压缩方法，专门针对 UMM 生成，通过指导一致的剪枝和校准注意力机制来提高质量和效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的剪枝方法主要源自理解任务，但不适用于 UMMS，因为它们缺乏对参考图像的探索，混淆了条件指导，并由于池化引起的偏差降低了生成质量。

Method: CATP 通过引入指导一致剪枝和泰勒校准注意力度量来解决这些问题。泰勒校准注意力度量为池化偏差提供了一个理论依据的二次修正，而快速评分操作（FSO）则将校准融合到分割在线 Softmax 中以降低剪枝成本。

Result: 实验结果表明，CATP 在代表性的 UMMS 和基准测试中持续优于最先进的 token 减少方法，达到 2.09 倍的注意中心速度提升。

Conclusion: CATP 提供了一种有效的剪枝方法，克服了传统方法的限制，并显著提高了多模态生成任务中的生成质量和模型效率。

Abstract: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) enable powerful multi-image synthesis but incur substantial computation from long visual contexts. While token pruning offers a direct route to accelerating inference, existing methods are primarily adapted from understanding tasks, suffering from insufficient reference image exploration, confused conditional guidance, and pooling-induced ambiguity that degrades generation quality. To address these issues, we propose CATP, the first training-free context-compression method tailored to UMM generation, which \textbf{C}alibrates the discrepancies of general \textbf{A}ttention-based \textbf{T}oken \textbf{P}runing for better quality-efficiency trade-off. Concretely, building on independent layer-wise pruning during denoising, we introduce Guidance-Consistent Pruning (GCP) to synchronize pruning decisions across conditioning branches, and a Taylor-Calibrated Attention Metric (TCAM) that derives a theoretically grounded second-order correction for pooling-induced bias. In addition, a Fast Scoring Operator (FSO) fuses the calibration into tiled online Softmax to reduce pruning cost. Extensive experiments across representative UMMs and benchmarks demonstrate that CATP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art token-reduction methods, achieving up to 2.09$\times$ attention-core speedup.

</details>


### [103] [Regional Anchor Routing for Multi-Object Motion Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39478)
*Yuze Li,Fuchen Long,Xinlong Sun,Cheng Yan,Xinyu Zhang,Xi Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RART框架通过掩码参考视频中提取时间有序特征，并使用目标前景掩码进行条件化，将动作令牌与目标区域锚定。帧对齐的动作交叉注意力确保生成帧仅读取对应时间槽的动作令牌，实现一次性去噪过程中的所有对象动作组合。实验表明，RART在动作保持、高效推理和较强组成泛化方面表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的动作转移方法通常难以确保将不同的参考动作正确地分配给目标对象，且针对参考视频的更新需要重新优化，导致反复的动作转移变得低效。

Method: RART框架结合对象级别动作提取、目标区域锚定和帧对齐注入，利用冻结的视频扩散转换器实现多对象动作转移。具体方法包括从掩码参考视频中提取时间序列特征，条件化于目标首帧掩码形成锚定动作令牌，并通过帧对齐动作交叉注意力实现生成帧的组合。

Result: RART能够在无需对每个视频执行优化的情况下处理新的参考-目标组合，实验结果显示，RART实现了准确的动作保持、高效的推理和强大的组合泛化。

Conclusion: RART为多对象动作转移提供了一种新颖的解决方案，有效解决了现有方法中的问题，并展示了良好的性能。

Abstract: Compositional motion transfer requires a model to extract motions from multiple reference videos, and apply each motion to a user-specified object in one target scene. Existing methods normally struggle to reliably assign different reference motions to the correct target objects, thus a motion intended for one object may affect another. Meanwhile, some motion-specific tuning approaches are still facing another issue: they must run a new optimization whenever the reference video changes, making repeated transfers inefficient. To address these limitations, we propose RART, a framework that unifies object-wise motion extraction, target-region anchoring, and frame-aligned injection into a frozen video Diffusion Transformer for multi-object motion transfer. For each reference motion, RART extracts temporally ordered features from the masked reference video, and then conditions them on the target first-frame mask to form mask-anchored motion tokens. Frame-aligned motion cross-attention allows each generated frame to read only the motion tokens at the corresponding time slots, composing all object motions in one denoising process. During training, a motion-attention routing loss encourages each target region to attend to its corresponding motion tokens and reduces interference between objects. Therefore, RART can handle novel reference-target combinations without per-video optimization. Experiments show that RART achieves accurate motion preservation, efficient inference, and strong compositional generalization.

</details>


### [104] [Agent-Wise Test-Time Normalization for Camera-Based Cooperative Perception with Corrupted Collaborators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39505)
*Yu Wang,Shaohua Wang,Yicheng Li,Kecheng Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文探讨了一种在车辆检测超越其视野范围的物体时的合作感知方法。文中指出标准的测试时批量归一化调整会损害未受损车辆的检测性能。因此，作者提出了一种代理归一化（AgentNorm）方法，该方法能够有效提升检测性能并在实际数据集上取得了显著效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本文探讨了如何在存在特定干扰（如雾、运动模糊）情况下，通过调整批量归一化（Batch Normalization, BN）的标准化统计值，提高多车辆间合作感知的有效性，从而提升目标检测的性能。

Method: 提出了一种代理归一化（AgentNorm）方法，该方法首先从每个合作车辆的当前观测值估计算法归一化的统计值，然后固定未受损车辆的原始统计值，以保持模型路径不变。

Result: 在合成数据集Camera-based OPV2V上，AgentNorm在严重程度5的雾条件下将AP@0.5从29.42-37.25提高到43.32-58.86，在运动模糊和雾环境下的表现优于批量归一化方法，额外延迟为每帧2.3毫秒。此外，该方法在真实世界DAIR-V2X-C数据集上的所有基础设施干扰场景中也优于批量归一化。

Conclusion: 本文提出的方法提高了多车辆合作感知中的目标检测性能，尤其在特定干扰场景下效果显著，并且该方法简单有效，无需额外的训练或参数，适用于实际应用。

Abstract: Intermediate-fusion cooperative perception lets a vehicle detect objects beyond its own field of view by fusing features shared by nearby agents. When only a collaborator's cameras are degraded by fog, motion blur or exposure errors, the features it shares drift away from the training distribution while the ego input stays clean, and cooperation can become worse than not cooperating at all. Test-time batch-normalization adaptation, the standard training-free remedy, estimates statistics over the pooled batch of all agents and therefore normalizes both the clean ego and the corrupted collaborator with a mixture of two distributions. We show that this mixing harms even the clean ego: when the ego shares BN statistics with a corrupted collaborator, its detection from its own features drops by 3.58 to 6.68 AP@0.5 points although its cameras are untouched. We propose AgentNorm, an agent-wise test-time normalization that i) estimates the normalization statistics of every collaborator from its own current observation and ii) anchors the ego to its source statistics, so that the ego path remains exactly the original model. AgentNorm has no learnable parameters, needs no gradients or labels, is independent of the order of test frames, and runs locally on each agent without changing the transmitted features. On camera-based OPV2V with four fusion checkpoints and collaborator-only corruptions, AgentNorm raises AP@0.5 under severity-5 fog from 29.42-37.25 to 43.32-58.86 and outperforms pooled normalization by 5.53-12.94 points under fog and motion blur, at an extra latency of 2.3 ms per frame. On the real-world DAIR-V2X-C dataset, it outperforms pooled normalization in all ten infrastructure-corruption settings. We also report the cases it does not fix: occlusion, which removes image content rather than shifting feature statistics, and the case in which all agents share the same shift.

</details>


### [105] [Robust LIDAR Sensor-to-Sensor Domain Generalization via Accumulated-Point Scene Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39516)
*Christoph B Rist,Larissa T Triess,Markus Enzweiler,Dariu M Gavrila*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究了一种无需目标数据和标签的源域训练方案，通过添加占用预测辅助目标优化点云语义分割模型，提高新域适应性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 鉴于实际LIDAR传感器具有特定的采样模式，跨数据集迁移学习受到阻碍。本文研究如何改进模型性能，使之适用于未见过的传感器，无需对输入进行修改，也无额外的推理成本。

Method: 引入一种基于源域的训练方案，通过添加一个额外的占用预测辅助目标来增强监督信号。利用采集的源域扫描数据构建简化的世界模型，并将其用作监督信号，替代传统的单帧标准分割训练。

Result: 通过实验评估，展示了模型在新域中的泛化能力可以通过合适的监督方法显著提高。在某些配置中，模型在未见过的域中表现优于其他方法，而无需显式领域适应和额外推理成本。

Conclusion: 研究强调了合适的监督信号对于改善模型在新数据集上的泛化能力的重要性，同时也验证了提出的优化方案的有效性和适用性。

Abstract: We study domain generalization for LIDAR semantic segmentation. Deep neural networks achieve strong performance on 3D point clouds, yet real-world LIDAR exhibits sensor-specific sampling patterns that hinder transfer across datasets. In many applications, performance on completely unseen sensors is crucial. A model should preferably work on a new setup without prior access to its data or labels. To this end, we introduce a source-only training scheme that adds an occupancy prediction auxiliary objective. We aggregate source-domain scans into a simple world model and use it as the supervision signal, replacing single-scan standard segmentation training.
  A key property of our approach is that it does not alter the input scan. During training and testing the network consumes the same single-frame LIDAR input, only the supervision signal is enriched via the occupancy objective. At deployment, there is no runtime overhead as the auxiliary head can be dropped for pure segmentation, or kept to obtain scene completion alongside semantic segmentation. In an experimental evaluation across distinct LIDAR datasets, we demonstrate that a model's generalization to new domains can be significantly affected by how it is supervised. In certain setups, performance on unseen domains improves without any explicit domain adaptation (no target scans, no target labels, no sensor priors) and without prediction refinement. At the same time, our method maintains competitive source-domain segmentation performance and incurs no additional inference cost.

</details>


### [106] [FFAI: Flow Matching with Feedback Training and Adaptive Initialization for CT Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39517)
*Jigang Duan,Heran Wang,Genwei Ma,Xing Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种统一的条件流匹配方法，通过反馈感知训练和退化适配初始化，提高了图像重建质量，特别在处理预测误差时表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低剂量、稀疏视图和有限角度CT由于测量信息较少而具有重建挑战，尽管具有不同的降解机制，但可以统一在一个框架下解决。

Method: 提出了一种统一条件流匹配方法。该方法通过一个教师网络模拟推理更新生成偏移状态，学生网络从中学习恢复高质量的参考图像。训练过程中，根据噪声水平或缺失投影数据的程度选择初始状态的起始时间，并相应地调整初始状态的噪声。

Result: 在公共基准数据集上的实验表明，所提出的方法在所有三种重建任务中都优于对比方法，能够有效抑制噪声和伪影，同时保留解剖结构和细节。

Conclusion: 该方法能够统一解决低剂量、稀疏视图和有限角度CT的重建问题，提升了图像质量和临床应用的潜力。

Abstract: Although low-dose, sparse-view, and limited-angle CT involve distinct degradation mechanisms, all three pose reconstruction challenges due to limited measurement information and can therefore be addressed within a unified framework. In iterative image restoration with flow matching, prediction errors may cause inference states to deviate from the prescribed training path, while a fixed initialization may be unsuitable for inputs with varying degradation severity. We propose a unified conditional flow matching method that conditions on the initial reconstruction and combines feedback-aware training with degradation-adaptive initialization. During training, a teacher network simulates inference updates to generate shifted states, from which a student network learns to recover high-quality reference images, improving its ability to handle prediction errors. During inference, the starting time is selected based on the noise level or extent of missing projection data, and the noise added to the initial state is adjusted accordingly to adapt the starting point to the input. Experiments on public benchmark datasets show that the proposed method achieves better quantitative results than the compared methods across all three reconstruction tasks, effectively suppressing noise and artifacts while preserving anatomical structures and details.

</details>


### [107] [BRIDGE: Learning Brain-Gut Metabolic Evidence for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39520)
*Pengli Zhu,Ruxi Chang,Tianliang Yao,Yu Jiang,Shengyuan Liu,Yiyang Lin,Xiaoyi Duan,Shuang Wu,Yixuan Yuan,the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BRIDGE 是一种两阶段框架，旨在将脑-肠代谢知识转移到仅凭脑部影像的诊断中，通过脑到肠的潜在传输模块和疾病证据导向的脑部路径，增强了 AD 诊断的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的阿尔茨海默病（AD）诊断模型主要关注脑葡萄糖代谢，而未能充分利用肠道代谢信息及其与大脑的交互作用。BRIDGE 框架旨在通过整合脑到肠的潜在传输和疾病相关的脑部路径，提高诊断准确性。

Method: BRIDGE 使用两个阶段的方法，首先通过条件下的脑到肠的潜在传输模块将脑-肠代谢知识相结合，然后使用大语言模型指导脑部路径，结合反事实引导的残差融合机制，监督信心门控并动态调节跨器官信息的贡献。

Result: BRIDGE 在公共和私人队列上进行了广泛的实验，结果表明，与仅凭脑部影像和跨器官基准相比，BRIDGE 的 AUC 增加分别为 6.0% 和 5.2%。特别是其将互补的脑-肠代谢上下文传输到脑部，而保留脑部 PET 作为唯一的推理输入的能力，突显了其在临床诊断中的潜在实际应用。

Conclusion: BRIDGE 框架展示了将脑-肠代谢知识转移到脑部影像诊断中的潜力，提供了一种新颖的集成方法，能够提高阿尔茨海默病诊断的准确性。

Abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis may benefit from gut metabolic information associated with brain-gut interactions, yet existing models largely analyze cerebral glucose metabolism alone. Although whole-body fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography (FDG-PET) can provide paired brain-gut observations, routine brain examinations rarely include gut imaging, limiting direct use of this information for diagnosis. In this paper, we present BRIDGE (Brain and Gut Representation Integration via Distribution-Guided Enhancement), a two-stage framework for transferring brain-gut metabolic knowledge to brain-only diagnosis. Specifically, BRIDGE integrates a conditional brain-to-gut latent transport module and a disease-evidence-guided cerebral pathway to capture subject-specific cross-organ correspondence and disease-relevant cerebral representations. For the cerebral pathway, a large language model (LLM) helps organize literature-derived descriptors into human-approved semantic anchors that guide feature learning. Additionally, we introduce a counterfactual-guided residual fusion mechanism, which uses matched and non-matched virtual-gut evidence to supervise a confidence gate and dynamically regulate the contribution of transported cross-organ information. At inference, BRIDGE exploits complementary gut-related context using brain PET alone, without measured gut PET. Extensive experiments across public and private cohorts demonstrate that BRIDGE outperforms brain-only and cross-organ baselines, achieving AUC gains of 6.0% and 5.2% over its brain-only counterpart for CN/MCI and CN/AD diagnosis, respectively. Notably, its ability to transfer complementary brain-gut metabolic context while preserving brain PET as the sole inference input highlights its potential for clinically practical diagnosis. Our code is available at https://github.com/CUHK-AIM-Group/BRIDGE.

</details>


### [108] [MorphSIG: Subject-Driven Image Generation via Decoupled Anchoring and Feature Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39530)
*Hailong Yan,Yongrui Zhang,Xiangtao Zhang,Le Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MorphSIG是一种不需要训练的框架，通过将主体驱动图像生成重新表述为伪视频特征传输来实现复杂的图像生成任务，同时引入了新的基准数据集和评估方法，验证了其有效性和成本效益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基准数据集存在样式同质性和缺乏真实标注的问题，MorphSIG通过引入新的框架解决了这些问题，旨在实现高保真的主体一致性。

Method: MorphSIG包含两个核心模块：渐进解耦锚定和伪流引导特征传输。前者通过频域解耦和结构解混在去噪早期阶段打破结构锁定，实现自由创作与身份对齐的渐进过渡；后者构建一个潜空间伪流场来模拟图像到视频的时序一致性并精准传输主体语义。

Result: 大量实验表明，MorphSIG在姿态多样性和主体保真度方面显著优于基线方法，无需额外训练。

Conclusion: MorphSIG作为一种成本效益高的框架，成功地将静态生成和动态传播相结合，为高保真主体一致性提供了新的思路。

Abstract: We propose MorphSIG, a training-free framework that reformulates subject-driven image generation (SIG) as pseudo-video feature transport. MorphSIG contains two core modules: Progressive Decoupled Anchoring, which uses frequency-domain decoupling and structural scrambling during early denoising to break structural locking and enable a gradual transition from free composition to identity alignment; and Pseudo-flow Guided Feature Transport, which constructs a latent-space pseudo-flow field to mimic Image-to-Video temporal coherence and transport subject semantics precisely. To address stylistic homogeneity and the lack of ground truth in existing benchmarks, we further introduce a benchmark with diverse stylized subjects. Extensive experiments show that MorphSIG significantly improves pose diversity and subject fidelity over baselines without additional training. Overall, MorphSIG bridges static generation and dynamic propagation, providing a cost-effective paradigm for high-fidelity subject consistency.

</details>


### [109] [MOSAIC-Flow: Orthogonal-Axis and Status-Conditioned Fusion for Missing-Sequence Completion in Brain Tumor MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39534)
*Pengli Zhu,Zhihao Peng,Yixuan Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MOSAIC-Flow是一种用于缺失序列完成的统一框架，通过保留七个获取的卷积并在传输过程中固定它们，学习目标条件的流场，同时利用模态感知基底、正交轴精化和状态条件原型融合来保留三维表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的跨模态融合方法会模糊序列特有的对比度，并丢失详细的三维肿瘤细节，因此论文提出了一种新的框架来解决这一挑战。

Method: MOSAIC-Flow框架包括模态感知基底独立编码每个序列，正交轴精化捕捉轴向、冠状和矢状依赖性并保留三维表示，以及状态条件原型融合使用紧凑的模态和可用性标记路由和调制融合视觉表示中的聚合查询，而不依赖密集的体素对体素注意力。目标通道噪声的条件流匹配目标用于将噪声转运至单一缺失序列，四个Heun轨迹的平均值用于生成完成。

Result: MOSAIC-Flow在UCSF-PDGM的数据集上的评估结果显示，在所有八个单一目标完成任务中，它能够保持整个大脑和肿瘤区域的一致保真度，特别是在结构序列上表现出最强的性能。

Conclusion: MOSAIC-Flow通过学习目标条件的流场和利用模态感知、正交轴精化和状态条件原型融合，成功解决了跨模态融合中的序列特定对比度模糊和三维细节丢失问题。

Abstract: Missing-sequence completion is important for comprehensive brain tumor characterization, but cross-modal fusion can obscure sequence-specific contrast and lose fine-grained three-dimensional tumor detail. To address this challenge, we introduce Modality-aware Orthogonal-axis Status-conditioned Attentive Integration for Completion (MOSAIC-Flow), a unified framework for missing-sequence completion that learns a target-conditioned velocity field while keeping the seven acquired volumes fixed throughout the transport. Specifically, modality-aware stems independently encode each sequence, and orthogonal-axis refinement captures axial, coronal, and sagittal dependencies while retaining the three-dimensional representation. Status-conditioned prototype fusion uses compact modality and availability tokens to route and modulate pooled queries from the fused visual representation, enabling target-adaptive conditioning without dense voxel-to-voxel attention. A conditional flow matching objective transports target-channel noise toward the single missing sequence, while four Heun trajectories are averaged to produce the completion. Evaluation across structural, diffusion, and contrast-enhanced MRI in UCSF-PDGM demonstrates consistent whole-brain and tumor-region fidelity across all eight single-target completion tasks, with the strongest performance on structural sequences. Code is available at https://github.com/CUHK-AIM-Group/MOSAIC-FLOW.

</details>


### [110] [ROAD: Modern Adversarial Training for Simple One-Step Distillation at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39539)
*Xiaoou Li,Shan You,Tao Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR:  ROAD 提出了一种新的单一步骤对抗蒸馏框架，用于文本到图像模型的蒸馏，通过使用受控 Lipchitz 转换器头部和动态随机特征混合，并引入了对全输入-逻辑雅可比矩阵的惩罚，在 COCO-10K 数据集上达到了优异的 FID 分数，优于多步骤教师模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的蒸馏方法要么需要大量的训练资源，要么在现代规模上表现不佳。为此，作者提出了一种新的方法，旨在提供更高效的蒸馏路径。

Method: ROAD 方法包括替换经典的卷积头为受控 Lipchitz 转换器头，并使用 token 级别文本条件；随机特征混合的动态重新抽样；以及对全输入-逻辑雅可比矩阵的惩罚。

Result: 在 COCO-10K 数据集上，ROAD 在 SDXL 和 SD3.5-M 上分别达到了 11.03 和 13.73 的 FID 分数，优于多步骤教师模型。

Conclusion: 通过单步对策略蒸馏，ROAD 突破了现有方法的限制，提供了更平滑和更有效的方式在更小的计算开销下实现好的文本到图像模型。

Abstract: One-step distillation turns pretrained diffusion models into fast generators, but strong results often require substantial training machinery and compute. Pure adversarial distillation offers a simpler route, yet has struggled at modern text-to-image scale. To address this limitation, we propose ROAD (Representation-grounded One-step Adversarial Distillation), a one-stage framework that distills text-to-image models with one adversarial objective and a lightweight representation-space critic. First, we replace the classical convolutional head with a Lipschitz-controlled Transformer head with token-level text conditioning, which matches the semantic tokens of modern visual encoders. Second, we observed a fixed random feature mixing leads to long-horizon degradation. We attribute it to generator-critic co-adaptation around one realization-specific view, and periodically re-draw the mixing to keep the randomization effective. Third, for our dense and vector-valued logits, we introduce Jacobian R1 which penalizes the full input-logit Jacobian, overcoming pooled R1's limitation of neglecting most of logit sensitivities. A single adversarial objective then suffices: in one step, ROAD reaches 11.03 FID on SDXL and 13.73 on SD3.5-M on COCO-10K, surpassing the multi-step teachers at a fraction of distribution matching's training compute.

</details>


### [111] [Comprehensive empirical evaluation of feature extractors in computer vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39551)
*Murat Isik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究通过图像匹配挑战Photo Tourism 2020数据集，评估了一系列传统特征检测和描述符方法的效能，包括FAST、ORB、AKAZE等。FAST与ORB结合使用BF匹配器时表现出最快的速度；AKAZE在模糊、鱼眼畸变、旋转、透视畸变等条件下的表现尤为突出。研究发现这些特征提取器在多种条件下具有良好的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了评估不同传统特征检测和描述符方法的性能，尤其是在不同变换条件下的表现，研究使用了一个大规模的图像数据集进行实验。

Method: 研究利用了Image Matching Challenge Photo Tourism 2020数据集，包含超过150万张图像。评估的方法包括多种特征检测算法，使用BF匹配器进行配对比较。测试条件覆盖了旋转、尺度变化、模糊、直方图亮度变化、仿射变换、透视畸变、鱼眼畸变和含盐-椒噪声的场景。

Result: 研究发现，FAST结合ORB匹配器时表现出最高的效率；AKAZE在多种复杂变换条件下表现优异；BRIEF、SURF和DAISY等在特定场景下也表现出良好的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，根据具体应用场景选择合适的特征检测和描述符方法可以显著提高特征匹配的效率和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Feature detection and matching are fundamental components in computer vision, underpinning a broad spectrum of applications. This study offers a comprehensive evaluation of traditional feature detections and descriptors, analyzing methods such as Scale Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT), Speeded-Up Robust Features (SURF), Binary Robust Independent Elementary Features (BRIEF), Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF (ORB), Binary Robust Invariant Scalable Keypoints (BRISK), KAZE, Accelerated KAZE (AKAZE), Fast Retina Keypoint (FREAK), Dense and Accurate Invariant Scalable descriptor for Yale (DAISY), Features from Accelerated Segment Test (FAST), and STAR. Each feature extractor was assessed based on its architectural design and complexity, focusing on how these factors influence computational efficiency and robustness under various transformations. Utilizing the Image Matching Challenge Photo Tourism 2020 dataset, which includes over 1.5 million images, the study identifies the FAST algorithm as the most efficient detector when paired with the ORB descriptor and Brute-Force (BF) matcher, offering the fastest feature extraction and matching process. ORB is notably effective on affine transformed and brightened images, while AKAZE excels in conditions involving blurring, fisheye distortion, image rotation, and perspective distortions. Through more than 2 million comparisons, the study highlights the feature extractors that demonstrate superior resilience across various conditions, including rotation, scaling, blurring, brightening, affine transformations, perspective distortions, fisheye distortion, and salt-and-pepper noise

</details>


### [112] [BEACON: Distilled Begin/End-Aware Structured Decoding for Continuous Sign Language Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39553)
*Guohou Zhang,Kalin Stefanov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了BEACON分割器，结合四类标签、约束维特比解码和边界知识，提高了分割精度和下游词错误率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分割器主要基于局部边界检测，而该研究旨在评估分割质量对下游识别任务的影响。

Method: BEACON使用四类标签（开始、结束、内部和外部），采用约束维特比解码，并利用二元教师提炼的边界知识进行改进。

Result: BEACON在PHOENIX-14/BSL语料库中分别提高了分割F1分数（14.58/14.59）和边界F1分数（2.17/1.22），并降低了下游词错误率（9.10/4.15）。此外，分割F1与WER的关系更强。

Conclusion: 该研究建议在评价手语分割时考虑分割质量及其对下游识别的帮助，而非仅仅只是局部边界的准确性。

Abstract: In segmentation-based continuous sign language recognition, an untrimmed video is first partitioned into lexical units; segmentation is therefore a means to an end---downstream recognition. However, segmenters are usually judged by local boundary detection rather than by the quality of the lexical segments and the recognition they enable. We present BEACON, a begin/end-aware segmenter that combines four-class Outside/Begin/Inside/End (BIOE) labeling, constrained Viterbi decoding over eight legal transitions, and boundary knowledge distilled from a binary teacher into a shared student. Under strict no-cut evaluation with validation-based model selection, BEACON improves segment-F1 by 14.58/14.59 points and boundary-F1 by 2.17/1.22 points, and reduces the downstream word error rate (WER) by 9.10/4.15 points relative to the state-of-the-art in the PHOENIX-14/BSL Corpus. To examine which segmentation metric better reflects downstream recognition, we evaluated five distinct architecture families. Segment-F1 aligns more consistently with lower WER than boundary-F1 in both corpora (Spearman $ρ=-1.0/-0.9$ versus $-0.9/-0.8$). These results support evaluating sign language segmentation in terms of segment quality and downstream recognition utility rather than local boundary accuracy alone.

</details>


### [113] [DOSE: Dominance-Guided Ordinal Severity Estimation from Sparse Relative Annotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39584)
*Tushir Sahu,Hideaki Hayashi,Hajime Nagahara*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DOSE 提出了一种基于稀疏相对标注的医学严重性估计框架，通过全球比较图聚合观察到的比较来估计每个图像的支配分数，从而推断出连续的严重性轴，并转换为离散严重性等级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统方法将等级作为独立类别处理，而将医学严重性等级视为有序但现有方法往往将其视为独立的类别。DOSE 提出的方法利用稀疏的成对比较来推断有序的医学严重性，且不需要绝对标注。

Method: DOSE 框架通过全球比较图来聚合观察到的比较，以估计每个图像的支配分数。不同的支配分数之间的差值设置累积的间隔，使其在嵌入空间中进一步分开估计的严重性更大的成对比较。此外，还生成伪成对监督标量严重性头部。通过无标签评分校准将学习到的连续严重性轴转换为离散的严重性等级。

Result: DOSE 在 ACNE04、IDRiD 和 LIMUC 数据集上一致地优于成对排名基线，且是在不同的成对预算下的表现。

Conclusion: DOSE 方法利用稀疏成对比较来估计医学影像的连续严重性轴，并通过标签自由评分校准转换为离散的严重性等级，从而能够从稀疏的相对标注中学习有序的医学严重性，且在多个基准数据集上表现良好。

Abstract: Medical severity estimation commonly relies on absolute grade annotations, which are fundamentally ordinal, yet existing methods often treat the grades as independent categories. Learning-to-rank methods, which can be trained using relative annotations based on severity comparisons of image pairs, can provide continuous severity rankings but cannot directly predict discrete severity grades. We propose Dominance-guided Ordinal Severity Estimation from Sparse Relative Annotations (DOSE), a framework for learning ordinal medical severity from sparse pairwise comparisons without using absolute annotations. DOSE aggregates the observed comparisons through a global comparison graph to estimate a dominance score for each image. Differences between dominance scores set cumulative margins in the embedding space, so that pairs with larger estimated severity differences are separated more strongly, and also generate pseudo-pairs that supervise a scalar severity head alongside the observed comparisons. The learned continuous severity axis is converted into discrete grades via label-free score calibration, with tie-anchored segmentation as the main calibration method. In the experiment, DOSE consistently outperformed pairwise-ranking baselines on ACNE04, IDRiD, and LIMUC under different pair budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/TushirSahu/DOSE

</details>


### [114] [TactoHand: Learning Geometry-Based Dense Hand-Surface Interaction Fields from Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39585)
*Ziheng Xi,Weibo Li,Jiayi Yu,Sipeng Zheng,Wanpeng Zhang,Haiweng Xu,Hao Luo,Chuan Mao,Zongqing Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TactoHand可以预测手表面的接触、接近和3D力等密集的手表面交互场，通过单目视频数据，并且相比以前的方法提升了接触和接近的估计效果，同时减少运动预测中的定位和旋转误差，这一研究成果为不收集触觉测量数据的情况下学习手表面交互提供了可扩展且低成本的途径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了理解人类如何与世界互动，捕捉手部与物体的物理交互至关重要，但收集大规模的触觉数据需要专门的硬件。TactoHand作为一个创新模型，旨在通过单目视频来预测和估计手部与表面的复杂交互，从而降低硬件成本和加快研究进程。

Method: TactoHand模型通过对数据集的几何和运动分析，提取手接触、接近等信息，并使用一种时序变换器框架来整合多帧视觉证据，通过三个学习查询来解析相应的手表面交互字段，并且结合物理层的约束条件，提升预测精度。

Result: 实验表明，TactoHand在接触和接近的估计上优于先前方法，并且通过物理监督进一步降低了运动预测中的位置和旋转误差，帮助下游手部-物体重建等任务更为准确。

Conclusion: TactoHand提供了一条不依赖触觉测量数据，利用单目视频学习手表面交互的路径，展示了在手部与物体交互感知领域的可行性探索。

Abstract: Understanding how humans interact with the world requires a representation of physical interactions at the hand surface. Tactile sensing captures these interactions, but collecting tactile data at scale requires specialized hardware. We introduce TactoHand, a model that predicts three dense hand-surface interaction fields---contact, proximity, and 3D force---from monocular video. We derive geometry-based contact and proximity labels and motion-derived force labels from eligible training data within a curated collection spanning approximately 50 million source frames. TactoHand uses a temporal transformer to aggregate visual evidence across frames, while three learned queries decode the corresponding hand-surface fields. A differentiable physics layer further constrains force predictions using observed object motion. Across in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks, TactoHand improves contact and proximity estimation over prior methods. In addition, physics supervision reduces position and rotation errors in motion rollouts, and the predicted contact and proximity fields improve downstream hand-object reconstruction. Together, these results show a scalable, low-cost path to learning hand-surface interaction fields without collecting tactile measurements. Code will be released at https://github.com/zhenqis123/Tactohand.

</details>


### [115] [Operator-Aware Posterior Sampling for Multivariate Weather Downscaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39592)
*Carlo Saccardi,Rudolf Saathof,Geethu Joseph,Justin Dauwels*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种解决统计下尺度中两个挑战的方法，即不同再分析系统的粗化操作符无法捕捉不同数据源之间的关系，以及各变量的引导梯度差异巨大使得单一引导强度难以适用。通过学习前向操作符和按通道归一化梯度，本文方法可以在不改变先验的前提下，实现对不同数据源的适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统统计下尺度方法在应对来自不同再分析系统的粗化输入时表现不佳，并且单一的引导强度对于不同变量的梯度差异处理不当。

Method: 该方法通过利用配对数据学习前向操作符，并对每个通道的梯度进行归一化处理，从数学上证明这种归一化方式等价于在块最大范数下的梯度下降，从而使得单一的引导强度可以适用于所有变量。

Result: 实验结果表明，该方法在处理来自不同来源的数据时表现出较高的灵活性和有效性，并且能够保持原模型的性能。

Conclusion: 该研究提出了一种改进的统计下尺度方法，该方法能够有效解决由不同再分析系统导致的粗化输入差异问题，并通过前向操作符学习和梯度归一化实现了对不同数据源的适应性。

Abstract: Statistical downscaling is the task of reconstructing high-resolution meteorological fields from coarse inputs. A principled approach formulates downscaling as a Bayesian inverse problem, using a diffusion prior over high-resolution fields and incorporating the coarse field only at inference through a likelihood. This decouples the prior from the coarse source, allowing one pretrained model to adapt to different sources. However, two challenges limit this flexibility: (1) when coarse and target fields come from different reanalysis systems, no fixed coarsening operator can capture their relationship; and (2) guidance gradients can differ by orders of magnitude across variables, making a single guidance strength ineffective. This paper addresses both challenges within the guidance loop, leaving the prior unchanged. We learn the forward operator from paired data and normalize the gradient per channel. We show that this normalization corresponds to steepest descent under a block-max norm, allowing a single guidance strength across variables. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/CarloSaccardi/operator-aware-weather-downscaling.

</details>


### [116] [Evaluating Cultural Knowledge Editing in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39602)
*Malvina Nikandrou,Georgios Pantazopoulos,Ioannis Konstas,Alessandro Suglia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究通过CulturalBind基准测试集探讨了文化意识跨模态知识和概念级知识编辑在视觉语言模型中的挑战。发现当前模型在文化特定概念的识别上表现不佳，且现有的编辑方法在跨模态移植时表现不佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前视觉语言模型难以识别具有文化特性的知识点，尤其是来自欠代表地区的知识。因此，研究提出了一种新的方法——知识编辑，旨在提高模型在文化特定概念识别能力及跨模态知识整合能力。

Method: 研究构建了CulturalBind基准测试集，包含了6个领域中1000个概念的3200张图像，并通过预编辑评估和序列化编辑实验来评估现有的模型及编辑方法。

Result: 研究发现，模型常表现出基于文本的文化概念知识，但在从图像中识别这些概念时表现不佳。此外，现有的编辑方法能够纠正单一视觉识别错误，但在跨模态移植时表现不佳，且在序列化编辑时表现迅速恶化。

Conclusion: 研究提出，需要开发更为完善的方法，以更好地将多种模态知识进行综合，提高模型在序列化编辑场景下的表现。

Abstract: Current Vision-Language Models (VLMs) frequently fail to recognize culture-specific concepts, especially from underrepresented regions. Effectively injecting this long-tail knowledge into existing models remains a challenge. In this work, we investigate knowledge editing as a targeted alternative by introducing CulturalBind, a benchmark comprising 3.2K images of 1K concepts from 6 domains, designed to evaluate culture-aware cross-modal knowledge as well as concept-level knowledge editing in VLMs. Pre-edit evaluation reveals that textual and visual knowledge is decoupled: models often demonstrate text-based knowledge of cultural concepts but fail to identify them from images. We then evaluate editing methods in single and sequential scenarios. Although current methods successfully correct individual visual recognition errors, they exhibit low cross-modal portability, failing to integrate edits into the model's broader parametric knowledge. Furthermore, performance degrades rapidly under sequential editing, highlighting the need for comprehensive adaptation approaches that better consolidate multimodal knowledge over time.

</details>


### [117] [DiFuse: Fusing Native Diffusion Representations for Spatial Reasoning in Unified Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39609)
*Ruixin Fan,Weining Wang,Jiahui Sun,Tailai Chen,Jing Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 通过在结构保护的方式中选择性地整合统一多模态模型（UMMs）的原生扩散分支的中间表示，DiFuse 提升了空间推理能力，同时保持了多模态理解的一致性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的统一多模态模型在理解和生成之间存在信息流的不对称性，旨在通过选择性地整合扩散分支的中间表示来改进空间推理。

Method: DiFuse 方法通过系统地分层分析，确定哪些扩散表示是最有信息量的，并通过残差融合将它们注入选定的多模态解码器层，以与视觉标记进行空间对齐。

Result: DiFuse 在 UniWorld-V1 上的空间推理一致性改进超过了一个匹配的 SFT 基线，同时在通用多模态基准测试中保持了相当的性能。进一步分析表明，这些增益取决于扩散表示的选择、注入位置以及扩散特征与视觉标记之间的空间对应关系的保留。

Conclusion: 研究发现，当以结构保留的方式选择性地整合原生扩散表示时，它们可以为多模态推理提供补充的空间线索。

Abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) jointly support visual understanding and image generation, yet information flow between these two capabilities remains largely asymmetric: understanding representations routinely condition generation, whereas generative representations are rarely reused for multimodal reasoning. In this work, we investigate whether intermediate representations from a UMM's native diffusion branch can enhance spatial reasoning without compromising general multimodal understanding. We propose DiFuse, which selectively incorporates intermediate diffusion representations into the understanding pathway of UMMs. Through systematic layer-wise analysis, we identify which diffusion representations are most informative and where they can be integrated with minimal interference to semantic processing. Guided by these findings, DiFuse spatially aligns diffusion features with visual tokens and injects them into selected multimodal decoder layers via residual fusion. Extensive experiments on UniWorld-V1 show that, DiFuse consistently improves spatial reasoning over a matched SFT baseline while maintaining broadly comparable performance on general multimodal benchmarks. Further analyses show that these gains depend critically on the choice of diffusion representations, injection positions, and the preservation of spatial correspondence between diffusion features and visual tokens. Results on OmniGen2 further demonstrate the transferability of DiFuse across unified multimodal architectures. Overall, our findings show that native diffusion representations can provide complementary spatial cues for multimodal reasoning when selectively integrated in a structure-preserving manner.

</details>


### [118] [UniTele: Learning Device-Conditioned Degradations for Unified Smartphone Telephoto Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39617)
*Yuchen Zhang,Aojie Li,Wei Cheng,Xianfang Zeng,Runxing Liu,haixin hao,Gang YU,Xiaoyun Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种方法，通过少量设备特定的降级数据训练统一的超分辨率模型，以改善在手机上进行远摄成像时的复杂降级问题。该方法通过将降级学习分解为两部分可学习组件来实现，从而显著提高了图像修复的保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超级远摄成像的移动电话存在复杂的设备特定降级，传统的手工制作流程无法充分捕捉到，而收集大规模对齐的训练对既昂贵又难以扩展。

Method: 研究者通过在三款不同品牌的手机上拍摄相同内容的不同显示尺寸和放大设置构建了一个配对基准，从而将降级学习分解为两部分可学习组件，分别捕捉设备特定的成像特性和超远摄成像中的额外信息损失和伪影。基于此基准，该研究训练了一个名为UniTele的统一超分辨率模型。

Result: 与未经过适配的Qwen和FLUX基线相比，整个UniTele训练方案在保留外测试基准上的配对修复保真度和感知相似性方面有明显提高，产生了更为稳定和视觉真实的修复结果。
